name: tacsuite
description: TacSuite - portage TypeScript de PC-Tac et du Generateur d'OI (GStart-main)

scripts.test:pdf:gate: node tests/pdf/generate-from-fixture.mjs tests/pdf/fixtures/long-case.json --out=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tacsuite-gate-long-case.pdf && node tests/pdf/verify-structure.mjs ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tacsuite-gate-long-case.pdf --lenient --fixture=tests/pdf/fixtures/long-case.json && node tests/pdf/generate-from-fixture.mjs tests/pdf/fixtures/volumetric-stress.json --out=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tacsuite-gate-volumetric-stress.pdf && node tests/pdf/verify-structure.mjs ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tacsuite-gate-volumetric-stress.pdf --photos=58 --fixture=tests/pdf/fixtures/volumetric-stress.json && node tests/pdf/generate-from-fixture.mjs tests/pdf/fixtures/real-shape.json --out=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tacsuite-gate-real-shape.pdf && node tests/pdf/verify-structure.mjs ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tacsuite-gate-real-shape.pdf --lenient --photos=2 --fixture=tests/pdf/fixtures/real-shape.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:pdf:gate
